minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a 300 Holman Street ANR and approved the 190 Electric Ave solar stormwater permit with conditions.

The director reported the earth removal bylaw failed at Town Meeting, the board agreed to drop it, and the population study contract is moving ahead.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the 190 Electric Avenue solar stormwater permit with conditions, including a sediment basin first and a funded construction monitor.
The board approved an ANR plan for 300 Holman Street West on a roll call vote.
The board continued the 60 Elm Street common driveway hearing to July 13 at 6:35 p.m., pending building inspector feedback.
The board agreed not to take the earth removal bylaw back to Town Meeting, after the director reported it failed, and to turn to stormwater and open space bylaws.
The director said the population study contract falls within the amount Town Meeting approved for master planning and implementation.

why_it_matters: The solar project's monitor is to be paid by the applicant under the state review-fee law, so the cost of oversight is set to fall on the developer and not on the town budget.
With the earth removal bylaw dropped, the town has no new rule on earth removal, and the board's next bylaw work is stormwater and open space, which could come to residents as Town Meeting articles.
The population study is paid from money Town Meeting already approved for master planning, so it is not a new request on the tax bill.
watch_next: The 60 Elm Street common driveway hearing resumes July 13 at 6:35 p.m., with building inspector feedback due.
